description_en: Queries the list of files in the network disk and obtain the download link of the file
description_zh: 查询网盘中的文件列表，以及获取文件的下载链接
kebab_example: aliyun ecd list-cds-files --end-user-id alice --group-id cg-i1ruuudp92qpj0000 --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-3203570000 --parent-file-id 63636837e47e5a24a8a940218bef395c210e0000 --file-ids 635d3c12f70beed7b6f84a9bb7bd51aad9100000 --order-type CreateTimeDesc --status available --next-token aGN4YzAxQGNuLWhhbmd6aG91LjExNzU5NTMyNjgzMTQ10000 --max-results 100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCdsFiles

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user to which the network disk is assigned
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the team space
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enterprise drive
parameters.name: cds_id

parameters.help_en: The parent folder ID. You can obtain the value by using the response parameter `FileId` of this operation
parameters.help_zh: 父文件ID。可通过本接口的返回参数`FileId`获取
parameters.name: parent_file_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the files to be queried
parameters.name: file_ids

parameters.help_en:
The sorting method of the files.

Valid values:

CreateTimeDesc: sorts the by creation time in descending order.
ModifiedTimeAsc: sort the by modification time in ascending order.
NameDesc: sorts the by file name in descending order.
SizeAsc: sorts by file size in ascending order.
ModifiedTimeDesc: sort the by modification time in descending order.
CreateTimeAsc: sorts the by creation time in ascending order.
SizeDesc: sorts by file size in descending order.
NameAsc: sorts by file name in ascending order
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The file status.

Valid values:

available: returns only normal file.
uploading: returns only the of objects that are being uploaded
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The query token. Set the value to the value of the `NextToken` parameter returned in the last call to the operation. You do not need to set this parameter when you call the operation for the first time
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页最大行数。默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the logon region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to obtain the list of regions supported by cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 登录的地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id
